svg.title: ARCodec four-group entropy model and proposed temporal scheduler
svg.desc: Exact current 16 by 16 latent to four 8 by 8 windows layout, four parity groups, shifted block-causal transformer, progressive completion, and proposed phase-rotated reliable temporal context.
svg.text: Exact current 8×8-window dataflow first; proposed scheduling changes are shown on the same topology
Example H=W=16. General code accepts any H,W divisible by 8.
w00, w01, w10, w11 become separate batch items.
The entropy Transformer has no cross-window key/value context.
2. Block tensor and time-major prediction order
Outer order: frame first. Inner order: fixed physical parity group.
g0+g1 are even rows; generated vectors feed later blocks and frames.
3. Shift by one block, then predict 16 targets in parallel
Example target block s=(t0,g2). The source slot contains code vectors from s-1=(t0,g1).
allowed(query s, key u) = u ≤ s
Each colored mask cell expands to 16×16 site attention.
No target-to-target edge inside the group.
All 16 targets are predicted in parallel.
B. Proposed improvement on the same 8×8-window topology

g.text: g remains the physical parity class.
attention block id and packet section.

svg.text: Also unchanged: tokenizer, codebook, decoder and arithmetic-coder interfaces.
Causal sequence stays time-major, but each rank points to a phase-dependent physical group.
Temporal phases alternate which parity half is retained.
Full-rate path keeps all decoded history. Prefix path distinguishes transmitted and generated sources.
Use source_status_embedding in progressive eval and apply the new temporal trust mask.
No self-forcing rollout; still one Transformer forward during training.
